fact: Korea's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (via KOICA) lists an active 2026 grant of KRW 154,008,800 for a training course for officials of Tunisia's Office of the Prime Minister and related ministries in online talent-development (e-training) systems.
system: Capacity Building on E-training Management for Civil Servants in Tunisia

fact: The Ministry of Communication Technologies launched the Digital Learning Academy platform on 1 December 2023 to build digital skills among the state's 680,000 civil servants, managed by Smart Tunisian Technoparks (S2T) with GIZ present.
The ministry says the Digital Learning Academy platform is for all 680,000 state civil servants.

L'Economiste Maghrebin reports a KOICA-funded national e-learning platform with the Presidency of the Government and ENA, operational since June 2024, with four pilot modules including e-governance, offering training to public agents; no number trained is given.
